method.renderer_input_clock: FFmpeg default input normalization, retaining the observed stream offset relative to the container start.
method.replayed_frame_trace: FFmpeg stats_mux_pre records the originating frame number and input PTS for each renderer output.
method.independent_native_verification: A second decoder pass uses copyts and select by decoded frame index. Both fresh q=5 JPEGs must be byte-identical to the frozen full-frame evidence. SHA-256 framehash also records decoded native pixel data before JPEG compression.
method.evaluation_clock: Subtract the first decoded video frame media PTS from each selected frame media PTS.
method.pixel_hash_format: FFmpeg framehash SHA256 over rawvideo packets in the native source pixel format.
